title: What Happens to Your Body Without Enough Sleep?
description:
What really happens to your brain and body when you sleep, and when you don't? In this hand-drawn explainer we cover sleep cycles, brain cleaning, memory, microsleeps, drowsy driving, mood, hunger, heart health, immunity, caffeine, alcohol, naps, teen body clocks, and simple habits for better sleep.

Take the ZUPPY Tonight Test and tell me in the comments what changed!
